issues: PAYER/PAYEE NAME OVERLAP: payer is นาย เมธาสิทธิ์ (BBL 098-9-xxx249); payee is นาย เมธาสิทธิ์ จำปาทิพย์ (KBANK 052-1-xxx061). The KBank payer seen on other slips in this batch is 'นาย เมธาสิทธิ์ จ' (xxx-x-x6560-x) — a possible abbreviation of the same surname, but a DIFFERENT account number. If this is an owner self-transfer it is an internal transfer, not an expense (OCR_RULES 5.9), and booking it as Salary would overstate OPEX. If it is a payroll payment to a different person of the same name it is a real wage cost. Account ownership must be confirmed by the owner — not inferred from the name.
